page_title: KOL 2-1 BOC | FC Koln v Bochum 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

90+2' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) bravely launches himself at a cross from Benno Schmitz and gives Manuel Riemann no chance with a close-range bullet header into the right of the goal. 2:1.
90+2' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

90' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the right post. 1:1.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

90' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
89' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is booked.
88' The ball is cleared after Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
88' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
87' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Thomas Letsch has decided to substitute Matus Bero and he is replaced by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) replaces Felix Passlack.
85' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

85' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from FC Koln as they win a corner.
85' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
84' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Jan Thielmann is replaced by Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) is replacing Sargis Adamyan.
84' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.

83' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
80' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
78' Thomas Letsch decides to make a substitution. Philipp Hofmann will be replaced by Ivan Ordets (Bochum).
77' Here's the change. Kevin Stoger leaves the pitch and Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
77' The ball is cleared after Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
73' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
71' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
71' What was Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
69' OFF THE POST! Good play from Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post!
68' Takuma Asano (Bochum) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
68' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) comes onto the pitch after Davie Selke signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
67' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moritz Broschinski leaves the pitch and Takuma Asano (Bochum) comes on.
63' Timo Schultz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) replacing Eric Martel.
63' Substitution. Linton Maina makes his way off the pitch and Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) comes on as his replacement.
61' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. FC Koln force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
60' An attempted cross from Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bochum.
59' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
58' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
53' 0 - 1 Felix Passlack (Bochum) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
52' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
52' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. FC Koln will have an opportunity.
51' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
50' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

49' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Bernardo (Bochum) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Tobias Welz blows his whistle. Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The corner by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

45+2' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. FC Koln will take a corner kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' An accurate cross picks out Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
40' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) steps up to take the free kick, but his crossfield pass fails to reach any of his teammates.
40' Tobias Welz blows his whistle after Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Bochum earn a free kick.
39' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
37' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln). FC Koln win a corner.
35' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

34' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Manuel Riemann. This effort really didn't trouble him.
33' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.
32' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Erhan Masovic (Bochum) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
30' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bochum.
28' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
26' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
26' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
24' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
23' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul. Bochum have a free kick.
22' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
22' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is about to take a corner kick.
22' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Bochum win a corner kick.
21' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Riemann comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
19' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
19' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) launches a cross from the corner, but Manuel Riemann is alert to thwart the effort.
18' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. FC Koln force a corner. They send men into the box.
17' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Bernardo (Bochum) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

14' What a chance that is! Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
13' The corner kick from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
13' Half-chance! Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) plays a pass into the box, but Manuel Riemann reacts well to snuff out the attack. The referee blows his whistle, FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
13' Bernardo (Bochum) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
11' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
10' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
7' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
5' Bernardo (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marvin Schwabe, who smothers the ball.
3' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
2' Bernardo (Bochum) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
